details: Produce out of the valley to the Midwest

recipe.name: Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home: the home time the brief states (every night, weekends, so many days a month), in the reader's words. If the brief states no home time, lead with the schedule or the area that keeps the driver near home. The one fact that makes it believable goes on the second line, in a few words.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck parked on a quiet {street} at {time_of_day}, a porch light on, {season}, {viewpoint}, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: OTR reefer runs hauling produce out of the valley to the Midwest. You're out 2 weeks, then home 4 days — a schedule you can count on. Pay starts at $0.70 per mile and runs up to $0.78 per mile. 401k and a rider policy included. Must be 23+ with 2 years of experience.
en.headline: Out 2 weeks, home 4 days

es.primary_text: Rutas OTR con carga refrigerada — produce del valle al Medio Oeste. Sales 2 semanas y regresas 4 días a casa, siempre. Pago de $0.70 a $0.78 por milla, 401k y política de acompañante. Mayores de 23 con 2 años de experiencia.
es.headline: 2 semanas fuera, 4 en casa

en.primary_text: Earn up to $0.78 per mile hauling reefer freight — produce from the valley to the Midwest. The schedule is set: out 2 weeks, home for 4 days. Bring a rider along with our rider policy. 401k available. Must be 23+ with 2 years behind the wheel.
